emma_support: FYI - Cust987 reports embeddings suddenly changed size after we applied a pinned variant update this morning. Their index ingestion started failing with vector length mismatch.

raj_ops: Oof. Which model/variant did they pin?

emma_support: They pinned `open-embed-2024-small@v3` for stability last month. Today our control plane rolled a maintenance update and the customer saw vectors of length 1536 instead of 768. No obvious errors in their client, just assertion failures from the indexer.

lucy_sre: Do we have a request id or example payload/response? Need one request trace to follow routing.

emma_support: Sent sample to thread: request_id=req_0a9b2f, api: POST /v1/embeddings, body included model: "open-embed-2024-small@v3". Response vectors length: 1536. Attaching response snippet.

emma_support: ```json
{
  "request_id": "req_0a9b2f",
  "model": "open-embed-2024-small@v3",
  "data": [[0.001, 0.002, ...]],
  "embedding_len": 1536
}```

hugo_ml: Interesting. Two possibilities: 1) our routing switched them to a different variant (larger model) due to fallback or canary mapping; 2) quantization/batching path concatenated two lanes (batchpad bug).

raj_ops: Check smart-routing logs for req_0a9b2f. I kicked off a lookup. deploy-bot: started trace fetch.

deploy-bot: trace fetch for req_0a9b2f queued, ETA ~15s.

lucy_sre: While that runs, can you confirm the customer actually pinned using the exact identifier? We've seen clients omit the @v tag and end up on latest. If they pinned via Console vs API the semantics differ.

emma_support: Cust says they used the Console pin flow and UI shows "open-embed-2024-small (locked)". They included a screenshot.

hugo_ml: If Console shows locked, control plane should honor it. But a recent fix to variant aliasing allowed substituting compatible variants for performance; suspect alias map changed where alias -> fallback variant has 1536 dims.

raj_ops: Trace results: smart-routing routed to node pool gpux-07, variant resolved to `open-embed-2025-large@v1` (internal alias match). Routing policy flagged suboptimal capacity and applied variant_fallback policy.

emma_support: So we silently served the wrong variant. Customer unhappy. Severity P1 for them (indexing broke).

lucy_sre: Immediate mitigation: (1) revert alias mapping so pinned variants never get substituted, (2) roll back the policy change in control plane, (3) provide a rollback for the customer to repin their exact model id. Who can own the rollback?

hugo_ml: I'll own the alias revert. Quick patch: add a hard-check during routing that if a model is pinned at customer-level (pin metadata present), routing must not substitute variant unless explicit emergency-fallback header is set.

raj_ops: I'll coordinate with infra to force a temporary route override for Cust987 to gpux-02 pool where their original variant is cached.

emma_support: Logged the customer incident and shared mitigation steps. Asked customer if they can retry ingestion after we flip the override.

hugo_ml: Also let's add a short-term guard in the embeddings response: include model_resolved and embed_dim in headers, and add an assertion on client-side for obvious dimension mismatches we can surface back to customer. I'll open an RFC for permanent fix.

lucy_sre: Action items: hugo_ml revert alias map (ETA 45m), raj_ops route override (ETA 10m), support to confirm post-override ingestion (emma_support). Also generate a postmortem stub.

emma_support: Customer said they're willing to retry. I will coordinate. Will update thread after they test. :thumbsup:

raj_ops: Route override applied to Cust987. Please retry.

emma_support: Cust retried ingestion. They report success and vectors now 768. Indexer accepted batch.

hugo_ml: Alias map reverted and added pin-protection check. Pushed change to canary; monitoring shows no further misrouted embedding requests for pinned variants.

lucy_sre: Great. We'll keep the ticket open until we ship the flag that makes pinned-model substitution opt-in. Also add an eval that runs embedding-dim assertions across rolling upgrades.

emma_support: Closing loop with customer and offering SLA credit for the disruption. Thanks all.

hugo_ml: Follow-ups: (1) add automated test that simulates pinned variant under low capacity to ensure fallback doesn't change embed size, (2) add a tracing tag for resolved_variant in responses (PR opened).

lucy_sre: I'll draft the postmortem template and set a 72h deadline for the full writeup.

emma_support: Noted. Will mark as resolved once postmortem is in.
